create_pixel_wrapper: create a Wrapper instance that adds pixel observations to a dm_control environment
create_pixels_only_wrapper: create a Wrapper with pixels_only=True to discard state observations and return only pixels
create_mixed_observation_wrapper: create a Wrapper with pixels_only=False to include both state and pixel observations
reset_pixel_env: reset a pixel-wrapped environment and get the initial time step with rendered pixel observations
step_pixel_env: step a pixel-wrapped environment with an action and get the next time step with pixels
